high_level_description: The image is a product advertisement for makeup items by Victoria Beckham Beauty. The background is plain white, which helps to highlight the products. At the top of the image, there is an open compact makeup palette labeled "SMOKY EYE BRICK in Signature." The palette contains three shades: two lighter shades on the left and one darker shade on the right. The lighter shades appear to be for highlighting or blending, while the darker shade is likely for creating a smoky eye effect. The palette has a sleek black design with a small mirror inside the lid.
